skill.name: kling-3-0
skill.description: Generate short videos from text or animate reference images with Kling 3.0 through the RunComfy CLI. Choose Standard, Pro, or 4K and optionally request multiple shots with synchronized audio.
skill.summary: Create Kling 3.0 videos from text or reference images using RunComfy.
skill.author: prime-skills

security_audit.summary: Most alerts match Markdown formatting, reference links, placeholder URLs, or ordinary credential storage. The skill documents an unpinned global install and an authenticated CLI that can submit paid cloud jobs. Its examples risk unsafe shell quoting, and its workflow does not require disclosure of costs or reference-image sharing before submission.

remediation.issue: Inline shell examples can mishandle user-provided input.
remediation.suggestion: Serialize input with a JSON library and pass it as a separate argument using a shell-free process API. Correct the claim that JSON alone prevents shell injection.

remediation.issue: The global CLI install has no pinned package version.
remediation.suggestion: Recommend a reviewed CLI version from the official package registry. Ask the user before installing it and document how to verify the package.

remediation.issue: The workflow omits a preflight check for cloud data sharing and billing.
remediation.suggestion: Before submission, confirm the text, approved image URLs, destination, and estimated cost. Do not promise cancellation prevents billing unless the provider verifies it.

semantic_findings.title: Unsafe Input Interpolation in Shell Examples
semantic_findings.description: The examples place user-input placeholders inside single-quoted shell arguments. Direct substitution can break quoting before the CLI parses JSON, despite the claim of no shell injection risk.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: Shell parsing precedes CLI input parsing in the examples. The risk depends on direct substitution and does not apply when arguments are passed without a shell.

content.value_statement: Short video projects need different settings for drafts, reference animation, and final renders. Use Kling 3.0 on RunComfy to generate clips from text or images at the quality you need.
actual_capabilities: Select a text-to-video or image-to-video endpoint in Standard, Pro, or 4K.
Generate clips from prompts that describe camera movement and a sequence of shots.
Animate a publicly fetchable reference image and optionally provide an ending image.
Request synchronized dialogue, ambient sound, or music during generation.
Set clip duration, aspect ratio, negative prompt, guidance strength, and seed.
Use the RunComfy CLI to monitor jobs and download results to a chosen directory.
limitations: Generation runs on RunComfy and requires an authenticated CLI. Pricing depends on the tier, duration, and audio settings.
Each clip lasts 3 to 15 seconds. The skill does not join clips for longer sequences.
Image-to-video requires a publicly fetchable HTTPS image URL. Local image files are not accepted directly.
Only documented aspect ratios are supported. The 4K tier supports up to six continuous shots per generation.

use_cases.title: Draft a Vertical Social Clip
use_cases.description: Use Standard text-to-video to compare short vertical concepts before choosing a final direction.

use_cases.title: Animate an Approved Product Photo
use_cases.description: Use Pro image-to-video to add camera motion while asking Kling to preserve the product shape and colors.

use_cases.title: Render a 4K Event Screen Clip
use_cases.description: Plan a short multi-shot sequence with synchronized ambience and render it in 4K after reviewing a draft.

prompt_templates.title: Generate a First Clip
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a five-second Standard clip of rain falling on a garden pond. Use 16:9 and no audio. Show the estimated cost before submitting.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: create a single shot from text.

prompt_templates.title: Animate a Still Image
prompt_templates.prompt: Use my approved HTTPS reference image for a five-second Standard animation. Move the camera slowly closer without changing the object's shape. Confirm before submitting.
prompt_templates.scenario: Basic: add motion to an existing visual.

prompt_templates.title: Direct Two Shots with Audio
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan an eight-second Pro clip in 16:9. Start wide on ocean waves, then cut to foam from a low angle. Add synchronized wave sounds without music. Show the estimate before submitting.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: control shot order and sound.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a 4K Start-to-End Transition
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a ten-second 4K animation using my approved start and end image URLs. Mark two shot timings and specify the camera movement between them. Show the cost and wait for approval.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: control reference frames and review render cost.

output_examples.input: Generate a five-second Standard vertical clip of a ceramic cup with steam and no audio.
output_examples.output: Illustrative result: A silent 9:16 preview opens on a ceramic cup. The camera moves closer as steam rises in morning light.

output_examples.input: Animate an approved product photo with a slow camera move and quiet room ambience.
output_examples.output: Illustrative result: A short Pro clip moves closer to the product while keeping it centered. The soundtrack contains soft room ambience without dialogue.

best_practices: Describe the camera movement, subject motion, and lighting for each numbered shot.
Preview the concept in Standard before paying for a Pro or 4K render.
Use approved reference URLs and confirm the estimated price before submitting.
anti_patterns: Requesting more than 15 seconds in one generation.
Passing a confidential image link or local file path as a public reference URL.
Requesting conflicting camera movements or visual styles in the same shot.

faq.question: What do I need to generate a video?
faq.answer: Install the RunComfy CLI and authenticate with your RunComfy account. Generation runs on the cloud service, not on your device.

faq.question: How long can a clip be?
faq.answer: One generation supports 3 to 15 seconds. For longer videos, generate shorter clips and assemble them in an editor.

faq.question: Which tier should I choose?
faq.answer: Use Standard for drafts, Pro for higher fidelity at 1080p, and 4K when your final output needs native 4K resolution.

faq.question: Can I use my own image and specify the ending?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide an approved, publicly fetchable HTTPS source image URL. You can also provide an ending image URL to guide the final frame.

faq.question: Can the model generate sound?
faq.answer: Yes. You can request synchronized dialogue, ambience, or music. Check RunComfy pricing because audio can increase the Standard or Pro rate.

faq.question: Can one clip contain multiple shots?
faq.answer: Yes. Number the shots and repeat important character or product details. Review the result for consistency before using it.
